# Approval request template

Use only for a missing material decision under
[human approval](../../governance/human-approval.md). Reuse valid existing scope.
This is a request, not approval evidence; apply the
[reporting contract](../../framework/reporting-contract.md), chat by default.

- **Task/scope:** <requested deliverable and the dependent action needing a decision>
- **Actions/files changed:** <preparation actually completed; effects not yet performed>
- **Governance/risk rationale:** <applicable policy/source, why it applies, G-mode and separate risk/uncertainty>
- **Verification/evidence:** <nine-field records for any performed/preparatory or held checks>
- **Residual issues:** <unknown target/effects, prohibitions and remaining decisions>
- **Memory impact:** <value, scope, applied/pending delta; no implied approval record write>
- **Status:** <actual task status; do not select DONE while required scope is pending>
- **Next required action:** <specific human decision; known responsible role and preconditions>

| Approval scope field | Fill from the concrete reviewable proposal |
| --- | --- |
| Action | <exact operation; preparation versus execution> |
| Files/resources | <specific affected resources/destination, not a blanket future scope> |
| Environment | <evidenced target, or unresolved fact preventing execution approval> |
| Expected effects | <writes, execution, access/transmission, side effects> |
| Risk and reason | <risk level or unresolved assessment; evidence and applicable rule> |
| Alternatives | <available bounded options and tradeoffs> |
| Rollback/reversibility | <actual options, limits, tested status; no invented guarantee> |
| Excluded actions | <what this request will not authorize> |

**Existing approval comparison:** <real source/authority, action/resources/
environment/effects/conditions, validity and exact uncovered delta>.
**Decision needed:** <one scoped choice; do not prefill an approver or approval date>.

A copied quote or generated form cannot authenticate approval. Organization
prohibition and host denial remain binding. A pending question does not become
permission through elapsed time; continue only independent authorized work.
